goal: Define and enforce the required Knowledge Delta gate for infrastructure tasks without changing the compatible merged v1 serialization contract.

verified_facts.statement: The merged hwm-knowledge-delta/v1 schema already carries task_id, goal, verified facts with provenance, rationale-bearing decisions, changed components, tests, evidence, followups, and unresolved fields.

provenance.reference: I06 authoritative protected-main base containing schemas/knowledge-delta.v1.schema.json

verified_facts.statement: The existing Infrastructure CI executes full unittest discovery for workflow_dispatch, pull_request, and push-to-main paths, so a repository-level unittest can enforce the gate without a workflow change.
I04 defines milestone state as non-authoritative and completion as fail-closed on deterministic dependency, protected merge, candidate CI, and post-merge CI evidence.

provenance.reference: I06 authoritative protected-main base containing docs/I04_TASK_ISSUE_STATE_POLICY.md

decisions.decision: Keep hwm-knowledge-delta/v1 unchanged and add an I06 validation policy/gate around it.
decisions.rationale: No incompatible serialization gap was found; creating v2 only to add repository enforcement would be an unnecessary retroactive contract fork.

decisions.decision: Use knowledge-deltas/<IXX-NNNN>.json as the only canonical durable representation and require delta.task_id to equal the GitHub Issue number encoded by the task-id suffix.
decisions.rationale: This binds the machine-readable delta to the same durable Issue identity used by I04/I05 while retaining the milestone-qualified execution task id in the path.

decisions.decision: Require canonical deltas for every active or completed BUILD_STATUS task at I06 or later, while not synthesizing deltas retroactively for pre-I06 tasks.
decisions.rationale: The gate must remain required after completion/merge and apply prospectively from the milestone that introduces it without inventing historical records.

decisions.decision: Require at least one verified fact with provenance, one rationale-bearing decision, one changed component, and one test entry in addition to schema validity.
decisions.rationale: The v1 schema intentionally permits empty arrays; I06 policy must make durable rationale/evidence/result metadata mandatory without changing the serialization version.

decisions.decision: Enforce the repository-level gate through the already executed full unittest discovery path instead of modifying infrastructure-ci.yml.
decisions.rationale: The protected workflow already runs every test_*.py on dispatched source heads, PR heads, and main pushes, so repository-level validation becomes a real CI gate with no workflow or publisher mutation.

decisions.decision: Keep lifecycle/dependency/claim semantics outside the Knowledge Delta validator.
decisions.rationale: I04 and I05 remain the authoritative lifecycle and ownership layers; I06 is an additional fail-closed merge record gate, not a scheduler, claim service, or bootstrap generator.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Create hwm-knowledge-delta/v2 only to make existing arrays non-empty.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The existing contract can be strengthened by deterministic validation policy without an incompatible representation change.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Modify infrastructure-ci.yml to add a new shell step for the gate.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Existing full unittest discovery can execute a repository-level gate, so changing protected workflow code is unnecessary scope expansion.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Use milestone open/closed state to decide whether a delta is required.
rejected_alternatives.reason: I04 explicitly makes milestone state non-authoritative for execution and dependency gating.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Accept PR prose, Issue comments, or alias JSON files as substitutes for the canonical task delta.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would make representation and task binding ambiguous and would not provide one deterministic durable machine record.

tests.name: I06 deterministic Knowledge Delta gate suite
tests.reference: tests/test_knowledge_delta_gate.py; exact-head Infrastructure CI is required before completion

tests.name: full Infrastructure unittest discovery
tests.reference: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v; exact-head Infrastructure CI is required before completion
